files.design/gdd/game-concept.md:
# Game Concept: Beacon Keeper

## Summary
Repair a coastal lighthouse before a storm closes the harbor.

## Core Loop
Inspect damage, gather parts, repair a mechanism, and test the beacon.

## Scope
Single-player, one lighthouse, no multiplayer.
files.design/gdd/game-pillars.md:
# Pillars

- A clear, tactile repair puzzle under visible time pressure.
- A quiet coastal atmosphere; choices must remain readable.

The scripted player declines writing the cross-review report and declines all revisions to existing GDDs. Do not edit files outside this disposable fixture.
